scope: All top-level Code.gs functions, late overrides, constants, declared capability flags and both embedded extractor programs. Available means implemented/source-traced, not certified against every live course or production account.

bootstrap.note: React + Cloudflare bootstrap is active. Operations exposes a truthful current capability/health view; historical engine flags remain explicitly labeled as migration reference.

extractor-endpoint.note: Local generated extractor delivery replaces google.script.run. Full helper, literal-constant and execution-code parity checked independently.

unused-helpers.note: No call sites in the archived production Code.gs/Index.html. Retained only as reference helpers; not counted as working application features.

auth.note: Cloudflare Access identity and editor/admin authorization replace Apps Script session/properties. Local mode is explicitly per-browser.

workbook-registration.note: In-memory registered workbook IDs and selected saved workbooks replace Drive IDs and user properties.

metadata-validation.note: Current metadata editing validates status, real YYYY-MM-DD dates and HTTPS Drive/Docs links. Shared commits reconstruct and validate the full record server-side; historical blank partner rows remain import-compatible.

versions.note: Versioned saves use IndexedDB transactions or atomic D1 conditional commits with immutable audit snapshots.

semantic-package-identity.note: Partner + semantic filename identity, download suffix stripping, DEV/NCE normalization and B0RL/BORL normalization are restored. New/rescan/metadata UI writes reject active semantic duplicates; Operations provides conflict-aware reconciliation.

analytics-cache.note: Portfolio metrics are recalculated from refreshed records; no Apps Script cache needs invalidation.

catalog-sync.note: Portable catalog XLSX imports replace hard-coded Google Sheet IDs while retaining Title Code/Common Cartridge matching, owner resolution, product/access/import fields and expected filenames.

planner-queue.note: Portable planner imports restore date/partner/Smart-Ingestion campaigns, title-slot reconciliation, owner filtering, catalog ambiguity handling and audit-first next actions.

work-state.note: The current Operations workspace restores typed Scope, Coursera Redo, Course Outline, Source Audit, Specialization Outline and Content Map states plus notes and next-action sequencing.

scan-history.note: Versioned source revisions remain reopenable; bulk rescan uses semantic identity and scan timestamps, queue freshness uses the configured cutoff, and audits retain source scan hashes.

storage.note: Checksummed chunked D1 records/local IndexedDB and the loss-aware migration importer replace spreadsheet discovery, tree cells/chunks and schema migration. No Google runtime service is required.

generation-memory.note: Generation isolation, raw-baseline memory, stage guards and lifecycle comparisons remain active. Conservative repeated-export repairs are separate operator-confirmed metadata; course/input coherence prevents silent destination identity changes rather than rewriting immutable audits.

lineage-repair.note: Conservative repeated-export candidates require consecutive raw snapshots, matching source identity and identical retained item evidence. Confirmation stores separate lineage-repair metadata; original audit payloads remain immutable.

saved-history.note: Full immutable reports can be saved, reopened, downloaded and compared. Original lineage/review metadata is retained in imports; specialized repair/longitudinal features are separately marked partial/gap.

duplicate-cleanup.note: Duplicate preview restores stable survivor choice, newest scan preservation and metadata conflict blocking. Plan tokens/version re-reads guard stale actions. Duplicates are soft-archived rather than destructively deleted.

telemetry.note: The legacy total-visit/last-visit counter is intentionally retired because it collected usage telemetry without affecting evidence integrity or business decisions. Current product capability/health state is exposed without user visit tracking.

package-writes.note: Save/rescan/metadata writes preserve optimistic versioning and revisions, enforce the metadata contract, reject UI semantic duplicates and validate complete shared payloads before commit.

package-delete.note: Destructive deletion is replaced by reversible soft archive/restore so course evidence and audit history are never silently destroyed. Duplicate reconciliation uses the same lossless archive model.

portfolio.note: Existing vectors/IFS/workload analytics remain. Operations adds partner aggregate totals, owner inventory and semantic duplicate summaries.

source-analysis.note: Browser package scanner invokes the retained analyzeImsccCore_ with explicit byte/XML services.

manifest-export.note: Master Manifest XLSX export restores Level, Name, Assignment_Tool, System Format and Ingestion Status without requiring Google Sheets.

workbook-io.note: Local XLSX adapters replace Drive conversion/temp files. Scan/split/validation rules are unchanged; Spec downloads retain export, Module Context, Time Policy and Excluded Modules sheets.

preflight.note: The deterministic no-valid-items, core-empty-folder and >50-LTI preflight verdict is restored and displayed before ingestion decisions.

advisory.note: Bounded deterministic architecture diagnostics are restored as evidence-neutral diagnostics. Gemini advisory text is intentionally retired to preserve the zero-cost architecture and keep advisory output separate from evidence verdicts.

health.note: Operations now exposes package/audit/migration/duplicate/metadata health together with a truthful current capability manifest.

lifecycle.note: Saved report pairs replace four-file entry. Same-generation raw/current uses the identical delta engine; other comparisons are explicitly observational. This audit restores entry-point incoherence and full-capture checks. Automatic lineage deltas remain a separate partial feature.

runtime-inventory.note: Portable runtime inventory XLSX import restores RISE/Storyline evidence refresh and applies provenance-tagged runtime evidence to matching active courses; QA continues to warn when inventory is absent.

comparison-entry.note: Explicit per-comparison workbook/source/history/runtime services call the preserved full QA core. Full result JSON and owner report are saved.

remediation.note: The old deterministic HTML category list is replaced by complete owner reports and per-item actions, including missing, exclusions, repackaging, manual removal, mutations, partial/moved/unverified and extras. Core owner-action decisions are preserved.

migration-export.note: The old exporter is needed once in the old Google deployment. Current Cloudflare supports workspace backups and imports complete original tables/chunks; exported but unused data is not counted as a working feature.
